scope: Only design, direct critical source reading and hand calculations; no model, RTL edit, build or board run.

verdict.static_endpoint_reordering: 因为下面完整的目的页分组对照逐项复现了静态双端排序的全部收益，所以该手例不能支持独立机制贡献。
verdict.translation_pinning: 因为 ICCD 2018 原文明确记载整 DMA 传输所需 TLB 项先锁定、完成后释放，并提出逐 burst 退休来消除这种约束，所以不能把给 DMA 锁翻译或按 burst 释放本身作为独立贡献。
verdict.positive_hypothesis: 如果成功许可的实际覆盖范围及即时替换压力，使联合片段切分与有限驻留合同在同资源、完整完成成本下得到固定切分、普通页分组、双端 hit-first、同窗口软件重排及普通并行无法复现的有效完工点，而且最接近前作未覆盖这一联合动作，那么可以形成独立机制贡献。当前只有可执行假设，尚没有满足此条件的定量独有正例。
verdict.action: Stop bare static ordering/pinning as a contribution. Retain one bounded dynamic split/merge-plus-residency hypothesis, and first seek or refute its decisive witness. Do not enter RTL from this card.

problem_and_actual_reachability.scene: A batch of independent small DMA copies gathers or redistributes page-resident objects. Source reuse and destination reuse compete for a finite IOTLB working set. Different copies may belong to V and A, so reducing total misses is not sufficient to protect both.
problem_and_actual_reachability.legal_reordering: Only reorder descriptors inside an explicitly unordered batch before that descriptor's first externally visible VALID. Sources are immutable for the batch; destination byte ranges are disjoint and do not overlap any source. Ordered descriptors, fences, MMIO and producer-consumer copies delimit batches. Parent completion remains tied to all actual child W/B responses.
problem_and_actual_reachability.identity: Reuse requires the actual IOTLB lookup identity, including address-space/context identifiers, to match. Equal physical pages under different PSCID/GSCID are not automatically one cached translation. Cross-DMA common identity is a workload/configuration requirement, not a fact proved for the current board.
problem_and_actual_reachability.capacity: K=2 in the hand example means an effective two-entry translation budget, e.g. a deliberately retained two-entry quota. Production has a larger shared IOTLB. K=4 and reassigning two entries from A are mandatory controls, with the resulting A loss counted. It is invalid to pretend the whole hardware has only two entries or that the remaining fourteen entries have no opportunity cost.
problem_and_actual_reachability.queues_and_walkers: Five visible descriptors require five pending descriptor records or an equivalent paid software queue. This does not create five walkers or five outstanding permission contexts. The hand calculation executes copies sequentially; the performance claim must subsequently survive the existing two permission lifecycles and actual eight request-head slots/32 payload words, as well as same-budget increased concurrency.

native_interfaces.fact: The legalizer already chooses the nearer source/destination page boundary when R/W are coupled, supports independent boundaries when decoupled, and owns both source and destination state after accepting one request. It accepts a next 1D request only when both machines are done. Reordering or retaining multiple partial parents needs an explicit frontend layer, not an assumption that these registers already hold many parents.

The request/response interface and per-direction in-flight FIFOs are explicit. Last/super-last metadata is retired using real write datapath responses. Aggregating children must retain parent ownership and completion/error accounting. Parameter defaults at lines 24-30 are not production resource measurements.
A pending COPY requires source address, destination address, length and the complete option/context record. A schedule index alone cannot replace owned descriptor storage.

Earlier G prefix selection was covered by ordinary longest-feasible min(max_burst, safe_prefix+free_credit). Do not recycle that action as this proposal. Native PTE response buffering is also not the DMA payload pool.

prior_art.title: Scalable and Efficient Virtual Memory Sharing in Heterogeneous SoCs with TLB Prefetching and MMU-Aware DMA Engine
prior_art.coverage: The old DMA required locking all translations for a transfer; the proposed engine instead tracks each burst's success/failure and retries after the miss is handled. The retirement record includes addresses, length, AXI ID, DMA ID, read/write direction and state. This covers translation locking and burst-level retirement as primitives.
prior_art.non_coverage: This section does not establish the proposed costed, multi-DMA joint endpoint fragment-group selector. Its recoverable hybrid-IOMMU miss protocol is not automatically available in the native RISC-V IOMMU.

prior_art.title: Orchestrated Scheduling and Partitioning for Improved Address Translation in GPUs
prior_art.coverage: Combines observed TLB-thrashing-aware task placement, TB-based partitioning and dynamic sharing of adjacent sets. Joint scheduling and translation allocation is therefore already a published capability.
prior_art.non_coverage: The read sections do not define a COPY's source/destination permission pair or choose split/merge of a multi-range DMA parent. This distinction alone does not prove an independent rule.

prior_art.title: Overcoming the IOTLB wall for multi-100-Gbps Linux-based networking
prior_art.read_sections_lines: Locally inspected passages around 334-343 and buffer-recycling discussion; not a fresh full-paper review
prior_art.coverage: Placing buffers sharing a page in consecutive receive descriptors, reuse/recycling and batching improve IOTLB locality. DMA descriptor/page locality is not an untouched topic.
prior_art.non_coverage: It is not evidence that every two-endpoint online scheduling objective is solved.

prior_art.title: Avoiding TLB Shootdowns through Self-invalidating TLB Entries
prior_art.read_sections_lines: Primary abstract and Section III, browser lines 257-270
prior_art.coverage: Translation-validity leases expire entries and help avoid shootdown coordination.
prior_art.non_coverage: A replacement-residency lease is different: it must never extend mapping or permission validity. The common word lease is neither proof of equivalence nor novelty.

static_decisive_example.status: A genuine positive against specified greedy/source-group controls, but exactly reproduced by an ordinary destination-group control; not independent mechanism evidence.
static_decisive_example.all_start_state: Empty two-entry fully associative LRU IOTLB; all five descriptors visible; authorized stable same-context 4 KiB pages; source and destination sets disjoint; one copy at a time; each COPY consults source then destination. All peers start here, not from a candidate-manufactured blockage.
static_decisive_example.graph_reachability: These are five real single-interval COPYs, not an impossible pairwise-overlap triangle. All destination byte ranges are distinct. Six unique translation pages exist, giving a six-miss cold lower bound. If the application's dependency or descriptor-order contract forbids reordering, the example is not eligible.

controls.name: Dual-endpoint hit-first then oldest
controls.rule: For each pending edge count endpoints presently resident; choose maximum, breaking ties by original age. Complete it before rescheduling.

controls.name: Ordinary source-page grouping
controls.rule: Group by source page in first-seen source order, retain age inside each group.

controls.name: Proposed bridge-last endpoint group
controls.rule: Consume the two S0 leaf destinations D0 and D1, then use bridge S0-D2 and drain D2's remaining sources.

controls.name: Ordinary destination-page grouping, exact strong control
controls.rule: Sort by destination page D0,D1,D2; retain original age within a destination group. Requires the same five-descriptor visibility and no residency lease.

controls.name: Same-window software exhaustive order
controls.rule: Enumerate the 120 legal descriptor permutations, simulate the specified two-entry LRU trace, choose minimum misses and then weighted completion/age. Count CPU scheduling and queue publication cost. The destination-group order already reaches the six-page cold lower bound, so exhaustive order cannot lose the candidate's locality benefit.

quantitative_assumptions.meaning: 20 is an explicit abstract whole-permission-miss service time, not an observed board result and not 20 per PTE. If every miss requires three PTE reads, 7 vs 6 misses means 21 vs 18 PTE reads. A realistic model must replace this with the actual walk stages and overlap.
quantitative_assumptions.fixed_copy_breakdown: Two endpoint lookup cycles + one source AR + eight 64-bit R beats + one destination AW + eight W beats + one B + three frontend/retirement cycles = 24. This hand model serializes these services; all controls get identical overlap assumptions in any later model.
quantitative_assumptions.actual_work: 5 COPYs, 320 useful bytes, 320 read bytes and 320 written bytes; five source data AR, 40 data R beats, five destination AW, 40 W beats, five B responses, five parent completions. No shared data-read elimination is assumed.
quantitative_assumptions.candidate_planning_overhead: A net non-overlapped planning/lookup/lease overhead of 20 cycles erases its one-miss makespan advantage over greedy. The exact destination grouping also has a measured or modeled sorting/publication cost; none is assumed free in an end-to-end claim.

calculation.fairness: The reordered e4 completes at 108 instead of 260, but e1,e2,e3 each finish 44 cycles later. If e4 is V and the others A, report this tradeoff; if e1 is V the same schedule hurts V. This is not a Pareto improvement and cannot be summarized as both V/A getting faster. Both sum completion and makespan are exactly matched by ordinary destination grouping.

adjacent_counterexamples.single_change: Change only e4's source from S0 to a new page S3.
adjacent_counterexamples.result: Greedy now has 7 misses, which is the new seven-page cold lower bound. Keeping the old bridge-last order has 8 misses and costs 280 rather than 260 cycles. A correctly adaptive grouping policy sees the lost edge and should fall back; its special benefit disappears rather than necessarily forcing the bad order.

adjacent_counterexamples.single_change: Increase effective K from 2 to 4, retaining all descriptor geometry.
adjacent_counterexamples.result: Greedy retains S0 through the D2 group and reaches the same six cold misses. New selection and lease overhead can then only hurt this hand example. In production, compare reallocation K=4 versus the candidate K=2 while charging the other flow's capacity loss.

positive_redesign.name: Costed fragment-group admission with revocable translation residency
positive_redesign.new_action_sought: Before the first child VALID, select both which byte intervals become the next COPY children and a bounded set of future-use translations to retain. Decisions use actual successful translation coverage and replacement pressure, rather than only static endpoint names. A group may shrink or dissolve before commitment when its predicted avoided work no longer pays its descriptor/lookup and interference cost.
positive_redesign.not_claimed: No payload atomicity, no permissions inherited between devices, no cancelled AXI transactions, no free completed-translation cache, no free four-prepare queue, no claim that cost scoring itself is a new algorithm. Ordinary page-boundary splitting and pin/unpin are covered primitives.
information_contract: The frontend submits a pending child interval and explicit context, operation and parent ownership using the paid native two permission lifecycles.

A successful response may report exact checked coverage/page size plus an entry identity and invalidation generation. Merely seeing VALID or a non-fault completion encoding is insufficient; access_ok must be explicit.

The IOTLB offers replacement-only residency for at most a bounded quota and byte/time budget. An invalidation immediately ends the offer according to the architectural invalidation contract; it never extends permission validity.

Use only pressure and service estimates available now: measured miss service estimate, pending endpoint identities, and currently resident eligible entries. No future remapping, return time, or permission-success oracle.
executable_first_rule: 1. Maintain at most five parent COPY records in a paid queue; mark legal reorder groups using software-supplied independence boundaries. Preserve original age and per-flow service deficit.

2. At a child boundary, enumerate for each eligible parent only three lengths: ordinary maximal legal burst/page-boundary length; a shorter interval ending at an already granted endpoint-coverage boundary; or a merge of immediately contiguous source AND destination intervals with identical context/options and no intervening ordering boundary. AXI's own burst/page limits always win.

3. For every candidate, count actual new children, endpoint permission attempts, current nonresident endpoints and the resident translations with a future use inside the visible window. Form score = estimated avoided miss cycles - extra child/frontend cycles - charged residency-opportunity cycles. The opportunity charge is the positive service deficit of delayed competitors multiplied by the proposed hold duration; quantization, cap and estimates are explicit parameters, not future knowledge.

4. A grant can retain at most K_lease replacement entries and B_lease future bytes, with age bound T_lease. Acquire offers atomically as a set, or acquire none; never hold one new lease while waiting indefinitely for its partner. Expired, invalidated, pressure-rejected or nonpositive-score groups use ordinary legal-burst FIFO/age fallback.

5. Commit exactly one chosen child's immutable request record before publishing its first VALID. Thereafter retain it through handshake/backpressure; all actual R/W/B and faults belong to that parent. At most the existing two permission lifecycles are used unless an explicitly costed extension is adopted by both sides.

6. After a child really retires, update parent completed bytes/error and competitor service deficit, release leases with no remaining visible benefit, and recompute. Stop issuing remaining children on error as required by the chosen software DMA error contract; drain already committed AXI transactions legally. Parent completion is emitted once, only after all committed children have completed and the success/error summary is final.
positive_redesign.why_this_might_differ: A runtime coverage/pressure change may make a coarse parent span too many cold endpoints while a small prefix can exploit an already checked reusable pair. Conversely, retaining all pre-split children wastes frontend work when both checked endpoint ranges can be merged. The proposed contract allows changing that granularity before commitment. A static graph permutation alone cannot change child granularity, but ordinary dynamic DMA legalizers, 2D/SG generators and software with equivalent feedback may already supply the same action. That is the decisive comparison, not an assumed distinction.
strong_controls: All needed permissions prepared first and one-page-ahead write permission preparation, with the same owned metadata/result slots and successful-grant test.
Ordinary dynamic common-boundary legalizer plus dual-endpoint hit-first/age, the same residency observations, and a bounded ordinary pin/unpin policy. This is stronger than fixed 4 KiB splitting.

Fixed finest necessary page/burst splitting plus same-window software source/destination grouping, exact legal ordering for a five-parent window, and an autonomous child generator so MMIO-per-child is not artificially charged to only the control.

Same fragment candidates and same observations, but separate steps: choose age/least-slack parent first, then choose maximal legal fragment and retain next-use endpoints. If this reproduces the joint selector, do not claim joint decision novelty.

Same resource allocation spent on more useful IOTLB capacity, an extra ordinary context/prepare slot when affordable, or the existing actual in-flight head/data credits. Preserve actual native overlap rather than imposing this hand example's serialization.

The previously requested same-pool cache/token, occupancy-plus-partner and stage-aware completion controls remain applicable if payload sharing is added. This proposal currently assumes no shared payload; adding it later does not invalidate those controls.
positive_redesign.shortest_decisive_question: Can two real DMA traces with the same initial five-parent window and a legally different runtime translation-coverage or contention event require different fragment-group choices, such that the joint contract has a useful V/A completion point unreachable by the complete ordinary dynamic-boundary + same-information bounded pinning control? If the latter can select the identical children, leases, permissions and commits at the same costs, stop this mechanism before building a general model.
first_bounded_validation_plan: Hand-trace at most two such six-node/five-parent COPY graphs; enumerate every legal candidate child choice for the ordinary dynamic-boundary control, not only one heuristic. Include the original startup permissions and actual W/B/parent completion.

Construct one neighbor where coverage is already large or all endpoints fit, and one where V's age bound interrupts the proposed group. A quota/lease policy which only wins by starving A or using a narrower control is rejected.

Only after a strict trace or frontier separation survives add a small event model with the actual two permission lifecycles, unchanged data resources and explicit scheduling/lookup ports. A paired case which equalizes after costs is a stop result, not a reason to add instrumentation or compile RTL.
positive_redesign.missing_evidence: There is no independent positive trace yet for the dynamic rule. The static five-edge result must not be presented as its success. The parameterized opportunity score also needs a reason to outperform simpler bounded pinning at complete cost; an equation alone is not a contribution.

complete_cost_and_protocol_ledger.descriptor_queue: Let address width=A, length width=L, complete option width=O. N=5 pending parents require 5*(2*A+L+O) bits before metadata. These records may reuse an existing owned queue only if its real capacity/field lifetimes permit it; otherwise all controls pay equivalent storage. New per-parent fields include valid, owner, parent ID, age, done/error, completed or next byte offset, and outstanding-child count. With valid1+owner2+ID3+age8+status3+offsetL+count ceil(log2(H+1)), overhead is 5*(17+L+ceil(log2(H+1))) bits. An implementation retaining both current and completed offsets pays another 5*L.
complete_cost_and_protocol_ledger.lease_state: For E IOTLB entries and five parents: at least E*(lease_valid1+lease_owner3+remaining_budget_width+expiry_width) bits if each entry has one lease owner. Shared owner sets require E*5 bits or a bounded reference structure instead of the three-bit owner. Generation metadata must match the existing invalidation interface; no fixed bit count is justified without that contract. If success responses/PPNs are retained outside the IOTLB, count their complete VPN/PPN/context/access/page-size/generation state as a real translation cache; this card proposes repeated normal endpoint checks to avoid silently adding one.
complete_cost_and_protocol_ledger.queue_ports: Read and compare two endpoints per examined descriptor. A sequential existing-port scan takes up to ten lookups for five parents and perturbs normal requests unless separately scheduled. A parallel ten-probe CAM path is not free: count endpoint comparators, lookup ports, and the IOTLB critical path. A shadow resident-tag directory duplicates tags and invalidation traffic and is also charged. Lease acquire/release needs a write/merge port or arbitration with fills/invalidation.
complete_cost_and_protocol_ledger.search_path: The bounded rule examines <=3 lengths per parent plus legal adjacent merges. Serialize score evaluation across registered cycles and count decision latency; do not add a 15-way score/length/lease fan-in to the existing AXI critical path without timing/area evidence. Complete exact window enumeration is a software/control oracle for five records, not a proposed one-cycle circuit.
complete_cost_and_protocol_ledger.extra_transactions: Every child needs its actual read and write permission checks; a lease skips no access-right check. Each extra split can add AR, AW, WLAST, B, last/parent accounting and frontend service, even when bytes are unchanged. Every merged child must still split at physical AXI/page boundaries and permissions. Failed or cancelled internal planning attempts consume their already-issued walks and owned responses.
complete_cost_and_protocol_ledger.payload_and_concurrency: Keep real eight in-flight request heads, 32 write-data words and additional native pipeline buffers in both peers. Five pending parents do not create five payload FIFOs. If interleaving parents requires another data-owner lane or return demultiplexer, count bytes, metadata, ports and added FIFO depth before crediting overlap.
complete_cost_and_protocol_ledger.permissions_and_invalidation: Residency affects replacement only. New permissions remain specific to context, operation, range and current invalidation epoch; never authorize writes from read permission. Invalidation revokes offers and prevents reuse according to architectural completion rules, while already accepted AXI work finishes legally. Faults may leave partial data as in an ordinary DMA error contract; atomic all-or-nothing copy is not claimed. Unverified remapping/revocation recovery must be tested before a correctness claim.
complete_cost_and_protocol_ledger.backpressure_and_ownership: Choose a child before first VALID; hold its source/destination/length/ID/options stable while VALID waits for READY. Successful permission belongs to the request that obtained it. Children and parent completions retain IDs through reorder, AXI response reordering and stalls. Existing committed transactions cannot be reassigned to a more profitable parent.
complete_cost_and_protocol_ledger.deadlock_and_fairness: All-or-none bounded lease admission avoids cyclic partial reservations. Always retain capacity or a preemption path for an unleased miss. Never require a leased entry to wait for a completion that itself needs that same entry to be evicted. Bound groups by bytes and time and use per-flow age/deficit fallback. A finite cycle bound additionally requires bounded memory/consumer service; without it claim only arbitration fairness.
complete_cost_and_protocol_ledger.software: Independence annotations, descriptor construction, same-window visibility, MMIO/doorbells, parent completion coalescing and any interrupt/feedback round trip are end-to-end costs. Do not compare hardware-generated children with a control forced to perform one syscall per child when an ordinary SG/2D generator can do it.

independent_judgments.rule_novelty: Bare endpoint sorting and pinning have no supported independent claim here. The dynamic joint rule is a precise hypothesis with unverified nearest-prior and strong-control separation.
independent_judgments.exclusive_system_benefit: The complete static benefit is exactly reproduced by a simple destination grouping. No exclusive dynamic V/A gain has been derived or measured.
independent_judgments.engineering_feasibility: A five-parent pre-VALID scheduler is technically plausible, but it requires owned descriptor/child accounting, an explicit successful-translation information interface, residency state and safe invalidation handling. It is more than changing a priority bit; no synthesized cost or native-interface correctness has been verified.
independent_judgments.recommended_role: Backup hypothesis only. Promote only after a shortest decisive positive survives the specified dynamic control. The current negative static example is useful pruning evidence, not a proposed paper result.
